Product Features

  • A bed as individual as your child:A very nice half-height bed for playing and sleeping.The modern Scandinavian style of this piece of natural wood furniture fits into almost any children's room interior. With the mini loft bed, you can fulfil your little sunshine's wish for an exciting world of play and sleep and also give the children's room a charming retro flair.
  • Sturdy construction made of solid pine: The mini loft bed is made of two extremely stable materials, which are ideal for use in the children's room. It is made of high-quality pine wood and, thanks to the robust material, offers the necessary stability to withstand even the wildest romp of your child. The bottom of the drawer is made of MDF. The corner posts are also made of solid pine wood to give the bed even more stability.
  • Safer to the sleeping level: Half-height bed via a circumferential fall-out protection with a narrow entry area, so that your child can sleep well protected and protected. To ensure that your child can safely climb to the lying surface even at a younger age, he or she can also use the ladder to get to the sleeping level.

To ensure that your child can safely climb to the lying surface even at a younger age, he or she can also use the ladder to get to the sleeping level.
  • More storage space possible :D The depth of the drawer is 30 cm. You can easily store the duvet and pillow in the two drawers located under the lying surface. In the evening, take them out and the bed is ready for the night. The low ladder makes going to bed a small attraction every night and you can use the space gained under the bed as additional storage space for reading books and toys.
  • Refined details: The gentle white lacquer underlines the friendly, bright character of the furniture and makes the bed attractive for both girls and boys.
